sources.title: 128 Civics Questions and Answers (2025 version) — Form M-1778 (09/25)
sources.refresh_policy: Per official bank revision; USCIS republishes M-1778 when test changes (last: Sep 2025 — 2025 version implementing EO 14161). Re-pull on each major bank version release.
sources.notes: Primary corpus: all 128 Q&A verbatim. PDF metadata: created 2025-09-26, modified 2025-10-14. Public-domain U.S. government work. Fetched HTTP 200 via curl+browser-UA (JAM-03 route). anchors 128 per-fact source_refs (Q1-Q128 in blueprint knowledge[]).

sources.title: 2025 Civics Test — uscis.gov (Last Reviewed/Updated 09/17/2025)
sources.refresh_policy: Re-pull each build (per blueprint updatable U10: static rule, re-confirm each build). Also re-pull after any USCIS policy update or test version change.
sources.notes: Anchors: exam pass/fail rules (12-correct/9-incorrect), test version applicability rule (N-400 filed on/after Oct 20 2025), early-stop rule. Co-anchors U10 with S3.

sources.title: Check for Test Updates — uscis.gov/citizenship/testupdates (Last Reviewed/Updated 09/18/2025)
sources.refresh_policy: Re-pull EVERY build (Dynamic Facts Monitor 18 owns this cadence per blueprint U11, U1-U4, U9). Officeholder answers (president, VP, speaker, SCOTUS justices, cabinet) churn on elections/appointments. 30-day max staleness.
sources.notes: The officeholder authority: U1 (president), U2 (VP/cabinet), U3 (speaker), U4 (SCOTUS CJ), U9 (test version rule), U10 (filing-date rule), U11 (re-pull marker). Must be re-fetched before each build that touches updatable facts.

sources.title: USCIS Policy Manual Vol. 12, Part E, Chapter 2 — "English and Civics Testing"
sources.refresh_policy: Policy manual sections update when USCIS policy changes. Re-pull semi-annually or on any USCIS policy announcement affecting the naturalization civics/English testing rules.
sources.notes: Anchors: test format (oral Q&A, random selection), English reading/writing test rules, exemptions (50/20, 55/15, N-648 medical), special consideration 65/20 rule, officer stop rules, retake rules. Cited in exam_meta, not per-fact source_refs. Snapshot present.
